en_title: Mass Effect Universe Would Have Answered Trilogy Ending Questions and Squadmate Fates, Writer Says
cn_title: 编剧称《Mass Effect Universe》本会解答三部曲结局的疑问及小队成员的命运
opus_summary: 编剧Cat Valente表示，已取消的《Mass Effect Universe》原本会处理《Mass Effect 3》的不同结局，并交代Shepard队友的命运。团队还计划解答《Mass Effect: Andromeda》的部分悬念，并加入新的外星种族。

paragraphs.en: BioWare's canceled Mass Effect Universe would have addressed Mass Effect 3's controversial endings and the fates of Shepard's squadmates, one of the game's writers has said.
paragraphs.cn: 该游戏的一名编剧表示，BioWare已取消的《Mass Effect Universe》本会涉及《Mass Effect 3》备受争议的结局以及Shepard小队成员的命运。

paragraphs.en: For more than a decade, Mass Effect fans have debated how BioWare could reconcile the wildly divergent endings of Mass Effect 3 — and satisfy players who insisted that their particular ending choice should be canon (I see you, Destroy fans). But according to one of the writers behind the now-canceled Mass Effect Universe, the studio had actually cracked the puzzle before EA scrapped the project and closed BioWare forever.
paragraphs.cn: 十多年来，《Mass Effect》粉丝一直在争论，BioWare该如何调和《Mass Effect 3》中截然不同的结局，同时满足那些坚持自己选择的特定结局应该成为正史的玩家（说的就是你们，Destroy的支持者）。但据现已取消的《Mass Effect Universe》的一名编剧透露，在EA砍掉该项目并永久关闭BioWare之前，工作室实际上已经解开了这个难题。

paragraphs.en: Speaking during a reddit fan Q&A supporting the "Save Mass Effect" fan movement, Mass Effect: Annihilation novel author Cat Valente — who spent three years on the writing team for the unfinished sequel — offered a bittersweet glimpse into how the narrative team approached the franchise's biggest lingering questions.
paragraphs.cn: 在reddit上为支持「拯救《Mass Effect》」粉丝运动举办的一场粉丝问答中，小说《Mass Effect: Annihilation》的作者Cat Valente让人得以一窥叙事团队如何处理该系列悬而未决的最大问题，令人百感交集。她曾在这部未完成续作的编剧团队工作了三年。

paragraphs.en: While strict NDAs signed with published EA continue to prevent Valente from revealing specific plot details, she emphasized that reconciling Mass Effect 3's endings was front and center for the game's writers room, and noted that the team wasn't relying on a single silver bullet to bridge the 600-year narrative gap between the original trilogy and this upcoming fifth installment.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管与发行商EA签署的严格保密协议仍使Valente无法透露具体剧情细节，她强调，调和《Mass Effect 3》的各个结局是游戏编剧团队的核心任务，并指出团队并未依靠单一的灵丹妙药来填补原三部曲与这部即将推出的第五部作品之间长达600年的叙事空白。

paragraphs.en: "[We] worked specifically, and for a very long and laborious time, on handling the endings in a way that wouldn't piss everyone off, at least not piss them off completely, that wouldn't make them feel like nothing mattered, wouldn't privilege any one kind of player over another, but also allow us, somehow, to actually write a coherent story going forward, within the limits of having to do it in a playable mainstream video game and not a post-modern 3000 page novel," Valente wrote.
paragraphs.cn: Valente写道：「我们专门为处理这些结局付出了漫长而艰苦的努力，希望处理方式不会惹恼所有人，至少不会把他们彻底惹恼；不会让他们觉得一切都毫无意义，也不会偏袒任何一种玩家，同时又能让我们以某种方式真正写出连贯的后续故事，而且必须在一款可玩的主流电子游戏中完成，而不是写一部3000页的后现代小说。」

paragraphs.en: "Not for nothing, guys, but that's *kind of a tall f***ing order*. Part of the reason it took so long and Andromeda was in Andromeda is that figuring out an elegant solution to that problem turns out to be *really hard.* An elegant solution that we can do with current game tech, that will be approved by higher-ups, that doesn't take over the whole game and make actually telling a story impossible... it takes a long time, and it's not obvious how best to pull it off when you're the people who bear responsibility for pulling off one of, if not the, hardest nut to crack in game writing.
paragraphs.cn: 「不是我说，各位，但这他妈的要求可真高。花了这么长时间、而《Andromeda》的故事又发生在Andromeda，部分原因就是想出一个优雅的办法来解决这个问题，事实证明真的很难。一个能用当前游戏技术实现、能获得上级批准、不会占据整部游戏以至于无法真正讲述故事的优雅方案……这需要很长时间。当你们肩负着解决游戏编剧工作中最难啃的骨头之一，甚至可能是最难啃的那块骨头的责任时，最佳的实现方式并不显而易见。

paragraphs.en: "And it's become really clear that it's impossible to make the gaming community completely happy with anything no matter how hard you try, especially the ME endings that were so controversial, yet people feel so strongly about their own choices. We burned out so many valuable neurons going up against that problem. I know so many people think it's easy, just make Destroy canon and move on, but consider that, for example, I feel as strongly about Synthesis as others do about Destroy. And everyone feels strongly about choices mattering. Do you really think there is a single solution that would have satisfied everyone? In a *video game*?
paragraphs.cn: 「而且现在已经非常清楚，无论你多么努力，都不可能让游戏社区对任何事情完全满意，尤其是《Mass Effect》那些争议如此之大的结局，而人们又对自己的选择有着如此强烈的感情。我们为解决这个问题耗费了无数宝贵的脑细胞。我知道很多人觉得很简单，只要把Destroy定为正史然后继续往前走就行了，但请想想，比如我对Synthesis的感情就和其他人对Destroy的感情一样强烈。而且每个人都非常重视选择是否有意义。你真的认为会有一种方案能让所有人都满意吗？在一款电子游戏里？」

paragraphs.en: "But we did our best, and I think we landed in a good place," she concluded. "There wasn't one single solution, but several working together, and unfortunately I can't say any more than that."
paragraphs.cn: 她最后说：「但我们尽了最大努力，我认为我们最终找到了一个不错的结果。并不是只有一种解决方案，而是几种方案共同发挥作用，可惜我不能再多说了。」

paragraphs.en: As a hugely knowledgeable fan of the original trilogy — enough that she got the gig writing Andromeda's quarian ark prequel novel — Valente emphasized that the fates of the trilogy's loyal squadmates had also been a key consideration for the Mass Effect Universe team.
paragraphs.cn: 作为对原三部曲极为了解的粉丝——她因此获得了撰写《Andromeda》quarian方舟前传小说的工作——Valente强调，三部曲中忠诚的小队成员的命运也是《Mass Effect Universe》团队重点考虑的问题。

paragraphs.en: "You would have been able to know everything you wanted to know about them," she said, when asked for her own thoughts of what characters such as Garrus, Tali and Wrex did next. "I don't have headcanons about those fates, I have canon-canons. I know you'd have been able to find out about them because one of my jobs was to write all those fates and their possible variations (all then submitted to the room, workshopped with everyone, and sent to higher-ups for approval...)
paragraphs.cn: 当被问及她自己认为Garrus、Tali和Wrex等角色后来做了什么时，她说：「你们本来可以知道所有想知道的关于他们的事情。对于那些命运，我没有自己的脑补设定，我有的是货真价实的正史设定。我知道你们本来可以了解他们的情况，因为我的工作之一就是写出所有那些命运及其可能的变化（然后全部提交给编剧团队，与大家一起讨论完善，再送交上级批准……）」

paragraphs.en: "God, it was like being asked to stitch a nice border on the Shroud of Turin," she continued. "I put on my Big Writer Pants for that one and gave it every bit of talent I have, because I love those characters beyond measure, and they more than earned my best."
paragraphs.cn: 她接着说：「天啊，这就像是被要求在都灵裹尸布上缝一圈漂亮的花边。我拿出了大作家的架势，倾尽了全部才华，因为我无比热爱那些角色，而他们完全值得我竭尽全力。」

paragraphs.en: Of course, we know that Universe would have seen at least one fan-favorite character return: Liara, now 600 years older — around middle age for a long-lived asari. But what about others? Asked for specifics, Valente noted her NDA blocked her from confirming specific names, but that there had been widespread discussion of bringing back every character possible.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，我们知道《Mass Effect Universe》本会有至少一名深受粉丝喜爱的角色回归：Liara，如今她已年长了600岁——对长寿的asari而言大约是中年。但其他人呢？当被问及具体情况时，Valente指出，保密协议使她无法确认具体名字，但团队曾广泛讨论让所有可能的角色回归。

paragraphs.en: "I think the best way to answer your question is to say that any character who physically *could* survive, we considered allowing to survive into the new game and made decisions on them," Valente teased. "We thought about all the things you'd have wanted us to think about, and I hope you do believe that, because it's the truth. Everyone in that room loved those characters, or loved to hate them, as much as any fan. We took each and every one of them and their fates very seriously."
paragraphs.cn: Valente透露：「我想回答你这个问题的最好方式是说，任何在生理上有可能活下来的角色，我们都考虑过让他们存活到新游戏中，并对他们做出了决定。所有你们希望我们考虑的事情，我们都考虑过了，我希望你们相信这一点，因为这是事实。那个房间里的每个人都和任何粉丝一样喜爱那些角色，或者乐于讨厌他们。我们非常认真地对待了每一个角色及其命运。」

paragraphs.en: So, who could have survived? Alongside the asari, the krogan are another long-lived Mass Effect species — and some fans believe we already got a glimpse at an older Grunt in the krogan civil war artwork released by BioWare a couple of years ago. Could Wrex also still be around? While he'd be ancient, it would not be impossible. Synthetic characters like EDI could certainly be around (and even if you'd picked Destroy, could surely have been rebooted eventually from a backup).
paragraphs.cn: 那么，谁有可能活下来？除了asari，krogan是《Mass Effect》中另一个长寿的种族——一些粉丝认为，在BioWare几年前发布的krogan内战画作中，我们已经瞥见了年长的Grunt。Wrex也可能还活着吗？虽然他会非常年迈，但并非不可能。像EDI这样的合成人物当然也可能仍然存在（即使你选择了Destroy，最终肯定也能从备份中将其重新启动）。

paragraphs.en: And then there are the characters and plotlines from Andromeda — a game that's nowhere near as beloved as the original Mass Effect trilogy, but whose storyline was still expected to factor into Universe in some way. Indeed, Valente revealed, Andromeda fans would have finally gained the answer to some of the spinoffs lingering questions (which were originally set to be answered in long-scrapped Andromeda sequels). For example, fans would have finally learned the identity of The Benefactor, who funded the Milky Way galaxy's push to Andromeda for unclear reasons.
paragraphs.cn: 此外还有《Andromeda》中的角色和故事线——这款游戏远不如《Mass Effect》原三部曲受人喜爱，但其故事线预计仍会以某种方式影响《Mass Effect Universe》。事实上，Valente透露，《Andromeda》的粉丝本来终于能得到这部衍生作品中一些悬而未决的问题的答案（这些问题原定在早已被取消的《Andromeda》续作中解答）。例如，粉丝本来终于能得知The Benefactor的身份，此人出于不明原因资助了银河系向Andromeda进发的行动。

paragraphs.en: "There is an answer, and it was fucking rad," Valente said. "As the author of an Andromeda tie-in, I and one of the other writers [...] worked closely on closing out Andromeda mysteries and bringing it together with the rest of the story. We know who [The Benefactor] was. At least the six of us in the writers' room know, plus anyone who approved our narratives or saw our work in-progress. I wish I could tell you, sorry."
paragraphs.cn: Valente说：「有答案，而且他妈的酷毙了。作为一部《Andromeda》关联作品的作者，我和另一位编剧……密切合作，解开《Andromeda》的谜团，并将它与故事的其他部分联系起来。我们知道The Benefactor是谁。至少我们编剧团队的六个人知道，还有任何批准过我们的叙事内容或看过我们未完成作品的人也知道。我真希望能告诉你们，抱歉。」

paragraphs.en: Finally, and least surprisingly, Valente confirmed that Universe would have featured new aliens alongside the returning characters/races from the four games so far. (Would the bird-like raloi finally have appeared on-screen? We will now never know.)
paragraphs.cn: 最后，也最不令人意外的是，Valente确认，《Mass Effect Universe》本会在回归的前四部游戏角色和种族之外加入新的外星人。（形似鸟类的raloi是否终于会出现在屏幕上？我们现在永远不会知道了。）

paragraphs.en: "I don't think there's a problem with saying of course there were going to be new aliens?" Valente concluded. "We all pitched new species and some were accepted and moved along to art etc and some weren't. Same with the squad. All of us pitched squad members and our directors chose between the pitches. I can't give you any more than that."
paragraphs.cn: Valente最后说：「我觉得说当然会有新的外星人应该没问题吧？我们都提出了新种族的构想，有些被接受并进入了美术等后续阶段，有些则没有。小队也是如此。我们所有人都提出了小队成员的构想，由我们的总监从中挑选。我不能再透露更多了。」

paragraphs.en: While EA has officially canceled Mass Effect Universe and BioWare's offices have now closed their doors, fans are trying their best to show there's still huge interest in the franchise — even if any sort of U-turn on EA's decision currently seems unlikely. Some fans have suggested EA could alternatively be convinced to sell the Mass Effect IP to another publisher who would do something with it, but again this seems a remote possibility. EA can simply hold onto the franchise rights to leverage it in other games (N7 skins in Battlefield, anyone?) and continue profiting from ongoing merchandise and licensing revenue.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管EA已正式取消《Mass Effect Universe》，BioWare的办公室如今也已关闭，粉丝们仍在尽力表明人们对该系列仍有极大兴趣——即使EA目前看来不太可能以任何形式改变决定。一些粉丝提议，或许可以说服EA将《Mass Effect》的知识产权卖给另一家愿意利用它的发行商，但这同样似乎希望渺茫。EA完全可以保留该系列的权利，在其他游戏中加以利用（有人想要《战地风云》里的N7皮肤吗？），并继续从持续产生的周边商品和授权收入中获利。

paragraphs.en: It remains a heartbreaking end for Mass Effect, though there is of course one glimmer of hope remaining: the not-yet-canceled Mass Effect TV series that remains in development for Prime Video. Should this ever escape development hell and make it to release and be a success and convince EA it should give Mass Effect another go... well, maybe we'd find out what Grunt was doing 600 years later after all.
paragraphs.cn: 这对《Mass Effect》而言仍是一个令人心碎的结局，不过当然还有一线希望：尚未被取消、仍在为Prime Video开发的《Mass Effect》电视剧。如果它有朝一日能摆脱开发地狱、顺利推出并取得成功，说服EA应该再给《Mass Effect》一次机会……那么，也许我们终究能知道Grunt在600年后做了些什么。
